title: Western Cowgirl Bachelorette SVG & PNG
author: bykirstcodigital
description:
Create bachelorette apparel, accessories & more with this Gettin’ Hitched and Gettin’ Rowdy Cowgirl SVG Cut File & Transparent PNG File Duo!
WHAT YOU GET
✦ This listing includes a zip file containing 2x SVG files & 2x 300 DPI 5000x5000px Transparent Background PNG files.
✦ These designs are pink and the SVGs are layered (see images for how designs are layered).
HOW TO USE
✦ SVGS can be used in Cricut Design Space, Silhouette Designer Edition, Inkscape, etc.
✦ The PNG is a high resolution (300 DPI) image with a transparent background which can be opened in most software programs.
HINTS & TIPS
✦ These files come zipped, you need to unzip them to add them to your chosen software.
✦ Depending on how many colours you plan on making this design, you may need to attach/detach or group/ungroup layers of the SVG file.
✦ SVGS are designed to be used as cut files but due to their scalability they’re great for making lots of different high quality products!
✦ The PNG has a transparent background, so it’s great for making so many different products (e.g. stickers, sublimation products, art prints etc!).
